{{Quote|My mistress and I were on assignment for the Republic Corps of Engineers at Fort Garnik. Our team was sent to repair a malfunctioning power generator.|The droid S3-E3 appeals to Republic heroes for aid|<ref name="GP" />}}
The '''Republic Corps of Engineers''' was an organization of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Its purpose was to construct and maintain facilities for the use of the Republic and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].
